dedupe_keys.name: pypsa pl sectorally integrated modelling of the polish energy system until 2040

description: PyPSA-PL: Sectorally-integrated modelling of the Polish energy system until 2040 is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Patryk Kubiczek, Michał Smoleń (Instrat). This record contains all the scripts and data from the PyPSA-PL modelling exercise that supported the report: Kubiczek, P., Smoleń, M., Żelisko, W. (2023). Polska prawie bezemisyjna. Cztery scenariusze transformacji energetycznej do 2040 r. Instrat Policy Paper 06/2023. https://www.instrat.pl/polska-2040 The record structure is based on the PyPSA-PL repository https://github.com/instrat-pl/pypsa-pl (v2.1). Coverage: national (PL); the metadata date the deposit to 2023. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
